semiconductor_relevance: High — Park Systems Japan specializes in advanced measurement and inspection equipment for semiconductor manufacturing, particularly in atomic force microscopy (AFM) technologies.
summary: Park Systems Japan develops innovative atomic force microscopy (AFM) solutions that provide high-precision measurements essential for semiconductor device fabrication. Their technologies are designed to meet the stringent requirements of defect detection and surface characterization in advanced semiconductor manufacturing processes.
capabilities: Automated defect detection for 300mm bare wafers
Atomic force profiler (AFP) for chemical mechanical polishing (CMP) measurement
Electrical property measurement modes including SCM and SSRM
Non-contact measurement technology for ultra-flat surface characterization

regional_presence.Japan: Park Systems Japan operates within the Japanese market, focusing on advanced semiconductor measurement technologies.
